sections.heading: Introduction
body: To provide our services to you and deliver on our promises, Paelon Memorial Hospital Limited requires the use of certain personal data. To access our services — whether onsite, offsite, or through our online platforms — we may require you to provide personal data so that we can deliver a personalised experience.

In line with our commitment to preserve, protect and safeguard your data privacy rights under our applicable statutory obligations and internationally recognised standards, this policy sets out how we collect, store, protect and process your personal data.
It also explains how you can control your data, and how we manage, store, protect, share, retain or delete it. It will tell you about your privacy rights and how Nigerian law protects you.
This Privacy Policy is issued by Paelon Memorial Hospital Limited ("Paelon" or "the Hospital"). The words "we", "us" and "our" refer to Paelon Memorial Hospital Limited.

sections.heading: Consent
body: Please read this Privacy Policy together with any other privacy notice or fair processing policy we provide on specific occasions when we collect or process personal data about you, so that you are fully aware of how and why we are using your data.

By ticking the consent box on any of our forms, you agree to the terms of this Privacy Policy and allow us to use your data to provide you with the best possible experience. Every form on this website records which version of this policy you agreed to.
This Privacy Policy supplements our other notices and policies and is not intended to override them.

sections.heading: Scope of this policy
body: This Privacy Policy applies to personal data collected and processed in connection with the business of Paelon Memorial Hospital Limited. It sets out the Hospital's approach to personal data received from people accessing any of our services, whether in person, online, or through third-party referrals.
On this website, that means the appointment booking form, the contact form, the corporate enquiry form and the newsletter signup.

sections.heading: What information do we collect?
body: We collect personal data: any information relating to an identified or identifiable living individual, or pieces of information which, combined, can lead to the identification of a person. This includes data such as name, email address, phone number, home address and identification numbers. It does not include anonymised data.
Identity data — full name, maiden name, date of birth, marital status, title, gender, biometric data, next-of-kin details.
Contact data — home address, email address, telephone number.
Financial data — salary structure, bank information and payment details.
Transaction data — details of payments and services you have received from us.
Health data — medical history, diagnoses, treatment records and clinical notes relevant to your care.
Communications data — your preferences for receiving communications from us, and your communication history with us.

A booking made through this website collects your name, phone number, email address, preferred branch, service and appointment time, and anything you choose to tell us about your reason for visiting. Clinical records themselves are created and held in the hospital, not on this website.

sections.heading: How do we collect your data?
body: Direct interactions — when you register as a patient, fill in forms, correspond with us by phone, email or in person, or use our services directly.
Automated technologies — as you interact with our website we may automatically collect technical data about your device and browsing behaviour.
Third parties — we may receive your data from employers, health maintenance organisations, referral sources, or publicly available sources where you have lawfully provided consent for such sharing.
We do not use your data for any purpose beyond those listed in this policy, and we do not sell, lend or rent your personal data to any third party.

sections.heading: Why do we collect data?
body: To process your requests and provide you with our healthcare services.
To communicate with you about your treatment, care plan and related services.
To enable you to receive benefits with third parties such as health insurance or pre-employment medical checks.
To respond to queries and resolve problems related to our services.
To meet our legal and regulatory obligations under Nigerian law.
To maintain accurate and up-to-date medical and administrative records.

sections.heading: Lawful basis for processing your data
body: Under the Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023 (NDPA) and the Nigeria Data Protection Regulation 2019 (NDPR), we process personal data on one or more of the following lawful bases.
Consent — you have given clear consent for us to process your data for a specific purpose.
Contract — processing is necessary for the performance of a contract with you.
Legal obligation — processing is necessary to comply with the law.
Vital interests — processing is necessary to protect someone's life.
Public interest — processing is necessary for public health or safety purposes.
Legitimate interests — processing is necessary for our legitimate interests, provided these are not overridden by your rights.
While we primarily process your data with your consent, we may rely on any of the above bases depending on the circumstances.

sections.heading: How you can control your data
body: You have the right to limit the data you provide to us. You also have the following rights under the NDPA.
Request access to the personal data we hold about you.
Request correction of inaccurate or outdated personal data.
Request restriction of how we process your data.
Request partial or complete erasure of your personal data.
Object to the processing of your data for direct marketing purposes.
Object to automated decision-making that significantly affects you.
Request the transfer of your personal data to another party.
Withdraw consent at any time, without affecting the lawfulness of processing carried out before you withdrew it.
To exercise any of these rights, contact our Data Protection Officer using the details below.

sections.heading: Does Paelon share your data?
body: It may be necessary to share your personal data with the parties below, and we will seek your consent before doing so.
Corporate entities, where you are an employee referred to us for medical services.
The National Health Insurance Authority (NHIA) and other regulatory bodies.
Health Maintenance Organisations (HMOs).
Service providers acting on our behalf.
Law enforcement agencies or government officials, where required by law.
We do not share your personal data without your authorisation except where required by law or by contract, and we do not sell your data to any party for commercial purposes.

sections.heading: How we manage, store, protect and retain your information
body: We maintain appropriate technical and organisational security measures to prevent your data from being accidentally lost, accessed without authorisation, or misused. Access to your personal data is limited to authorised personnel on a strict need-to-know basis.

We have procedures in place to handle suspected personal data breaches, and will notify you and any applicable regulator — including the Nigeria Data Protection Commission (NDPC) — where legally required to do so, within the timeframes the law sets.
While no system is entirely immune to security threats, we commit to taking all reasonable and proportionate measures to protect your data.

We retain your personal data only for as long as necessary to fulfil the purposes for which it was collected, including satisfying legal, accounting or regulatory requirements. Once there is no further lawful basis to retain your data, it is securely deleted or destroyed.

sections.heading: Cookies and analytics on this website
body: This website measures how many people visit each page using analytics that set no cookies and build no profile of you. We do not track you across other websites, and there is no advertising network on this site.
The pages you visit are counted; you are not identified by them. Because nothing is stored on your device for this purpose, there is no cookie banner to dismiss.

sections.heading: Changes to this policy
body: We review this Privacy Policy regularly and may update it from time to time. The current version was last updated in March 2026 and supersedes all previous versions. Any material changes will be communicated to you where reasonably practicable.
Please make sure the personal data you provide to us stays accurate and up to date, and tell us promptly if any of your details change.

sections.heading: Contact information
body: For any query about your data or this Privacy Policy, contact our Data Protection Officer.
The Data Protection Officer, Paelon Memorial Hospital Limited, 1221 Ahmadu Bello Way, Victoria Island, Lagos.
Email privacy@paelonmemorial.com or call +234 809 888 8978.
If you are not satisfied with our response, you may complain to the Nigeria Data Protection Commission.
